title: Technical writer
description:
Job Description:

Schneider Electric is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Technical Writer** with **4–6 years of experience** to support our **Software & Services** portfolio.

The Technical Writer will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining high-quality technical documentation that enables customers and users to effectively understand, configure, operate, and troubleshoot software products and solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with R&D, Product Owners, Product Management, technical experts, and other cross-functional stakeholders to gather technical information and transform complex inputs into clear, accurate, customer-centric, and easy-to-understand documentation.

The role requires strong technical writing and communication skills, hands-on experience with industry-standard authoring tools, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple documentation activities in parallel. Knowledge and practical exposure to **AI-assisted documentation and content development** will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create, update, and maintain technical documentation for **Software & Services products and solutions**, including catalogs, user guides, installation guides, configuration guides, online help, release notes, and other customer-facing documentation.
* Analyse documentation requirements based on product functionality, use cases, target audiences, and available technical inputs.
* Work closely with R&D, Product Owners, Product Management, testing teams, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to gather and validate technical information.
* Transform complex software and technical information into **clear, concise, structured, and easy-to-understand content** appropriate for the target audience.
* Review and edit documentation to ensure **technical accuracy, consistency, usability, grammar, terminology, and adherence to corporate documentation standards**.
* Manage documentation updates in alignment with software/Hardware releases, product changes, and project milestones.
* Work independently on assigned documentation projects while collaborating effectively with other technical writers and global cross-functional teams.
* Manage multiple documentation activities in parallel and deliver assigned documentation within agreed timelines and quality expectations.
* Explore and effectively use **AI-assisted tools and techniques** where applicable to improve documentation productivity, content quality, consistency, and review processes.

(External) English Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in **Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Technical Communication**, or a related discipline.
* **4–6 years of hands-on experience as a Technical Writer**, preferably supporting Hardware, software, digital, or technology products.
* Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining customer-facing technical documentation such as user guides, installation guides, configuration guides, online help, and release notes.
* Strong ability to understand complex technical information and translate it into **simple, accurate, and user-focused documentation**.
* Strong knowledge of technical writing principles, information organization, content structuring, grammar, terminology, and documentation standards.
* Hands-on experience with authoring and publishing tools such as:
* + **Adobe InDesign**
  + **PTC Arbortext Editor or other XML-based authoring tools**
  + **Adobe Technical Communication tools**
  + **Microsoft Word**
  + **Content Management Systems**
* Experience working with **structured/XML-based documentation** and familiarity with content management or document management systems.
* Ability to work with engineering/R&D teams and subject matter experts to gather, understand, and validate technical information.
* Ability to manage multiple documentation assignments simultaneously while meeting agreed timelines and quality expectations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with **global and cross-functional teams across different locations and time zones**.
* Positive, flexible, collaborative, and customer-focused working style.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge or practical experience using **Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, or AI-assisted tools for technical documentation**, such as content drafting, rewriting, summarization, review, terminology consistency, or documentation automation.

Bring your talent for clear communication to a team that's ready to welcome you — apply today!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

title: threat detection engineer
description:
**what is CRED?**

CRED is an exclusive community for India’s most trustworthy and CREDitworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true

here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better

### **what you will do ?**

* work across a diverse information security domain, with a strong focus on threat detection, response, and security telemetry across infrastructure, cloud, and data
* identify and investigate security threats (internal and external), partner with stakeholders on remediation, and design preventive controls for recurring or systemic issues
* design, build, and continuously improve high-fidelity detection use cases across cloud, endpoint, identity, and network telemetry
* formulate new detection ideas based on adversary research, emerging attack techniques, industry incidents, and threat intelligence
* lead and participate in incident response, performing root-cause analysis and driving preventive improvements post-incident
* develop and enhance the CRED’s detection, monitoring and response capabilities
* automate incident response workflows using playbooks and orchestration to reduce manual effort
* build in-house security analytics solutions using open source tools (log parsing, event correlation and threat detection)research/conduct threat hunting operations using known adversary tactics, techniques and procedures to detect advanced threats
* assist with creating security awareness and maintaining prudent security engineering culture within an organization
* enable compliance in teams and help them achieve some of the industry’s best practices (e.g. PCI DSS, ISO 27001)

### **you should apply if you have:**

* 2 to 6 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on threat detection and response
* hands-on experience detecting and responding to threats across cloud (aws preferred), endpoint (windows/linux/macOS), and network telemetry
* exposure to EDR, IDS/IPS, and SIEM / centralized logging platforms (splunk, ELK, sentinel, or similar), including building high-fidelity detection pipelines
* proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (python, go, or bash)
* solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, cyber kill chain, and diamond model
* ability to design and tune detection rules using MITRE ATT&CK and threat intelligence with a focus on signal quality
* experience with threat hunting, automation and enrichment, regex creation, and false-positive reduction
* experience handling the complete incident response lifecycle, from detection through remediation and reporting
* strong data-driven mindset with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* ability to act as a go-to person, communicating clearly with engineering, product, and business teams
* proactive approach to staying current with security news, breach reports, tools, and attacker research
* strong learning agility and passion for exploring diverse security domains, demonstrated via github, blogs, research, or talks
* exposure to the AI-driven threat landscape, digital forensics, or malware analysis is a strong plus

**how is life at CRED?**

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you. not just in the role you occupy, but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, standup comic, artist, writer, an athlete, maybe a magician. at CRED people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

hard truths: pushing oneself comes with the role. and we realize pushing oneself is hard work. which is why CRED is in the continuous process of building an environment that helps the team rejuvenate oneself: included but not limited to a stacked, in-house pantry, with lunch and dinner provided for all the team members, paid sick leaves and a comprehensive health insurance.

to make things smoother and to make sure you spend time and energy only on the most important things, CRED strives to make every process transparent: there are no work timings because we do not believe in archaic methods of calculating productivity, your work should speak for you. there are no job designations because you will be expected to hold down roles that cannot be described in one word.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

title: Web Growth Manager
description:
**About the role**

JuliaHub is hiring a Web Growth Manager to own juliahub.com end-to-end: design an engaging, on-brand site, build and ship it in Framer, instrument every visit, and prove which web activity turns into sales opportunities.

JuliaHub builds Dyad, an agentic, Julia-native platform for engineering modeling and simulation, alongside the JuliaHub platform. Our buyers are engineers and technical leaders evaluating us against established dynamic modeling and control systems simulation tools. They research deeply, through search engines and increasingly through AI assistants, before they talk to sales.

You will be the single owner of the marketing site: its visual design, user experience, build, and measurement stack. You'll report to marketing leadership and work daily with the marketing team, application engineers, sales, and the development teams behind our products.

**What you'll do**

**Own the site's creative and experience**

* Own the look and feel of juliahub.com: apply and evolve the JuliaHub brand across typography, color, layout, imagery, and motion.
* Design page layouts, UI components, and a reusable design system directly in Framer.
* Create web graphics, illustrations, diagrams, product visuals, and simple animations that make technical products easy to grasp.
* Shape the UX: information architecture, navigation, page flow, and calls to action that pull engineers from first visit to trial or demo.
* Keep every product site and subdomain visually consistent, and set brand and style guidance others can follow.

  

**Own the site in Framer**

* Build, publish, and maintain pages, landing pages, and CMS collections (use cases, verticals, comparisons, FAQs, proof points) in Framer.
* Turn content into responsive, accessible, on-brand pages within days, designing directly in Framer.
* Run site governance: QA checklists, publishing workflow, redirects, navigation, forms, and a change log.
* Coordinate with engineering on DNS, CDN, and subdomains (help.juliahub.com, platform.juliahub.com, product docs).

  

**Drive organic and AI search growth**

* Own technical SEO in Google Search Console: indexing, sitemaps, canonicals, redirect chains, crawl errors, and Core Web Vitals.
* Maintain structured data (JSON-LD for Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication, FAQ, Article) and AI-readiness files such as llms.txt.
* Track how JuliaHub and Dyad appear in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) and optimize pages to be cited.

  

**Measure and attribute everything**

* Own GA4 and Google Tag Manager: event taxonomy, conversions, consent mode, and cross-domain tracking.
* Enforce UTM standards across campaigns, email, social, events, and partners.
* Connect web activity to Salesforce: form-to-lead routing, campaign membership, and offline conversion import.
* Build and maintain attribution reporting (first-touch, last-touch, and multi-touch) that ties web sessions to sourced and influenced pipeline.
* Publish a weekly web dashboard and a monthly growth readout with clear recommendations.

  

**Optimize conversion**

* Run A/B tests on headlines, CTAs, forms, and page layouts; report lift with sample sizes.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings to find and fix drop-off on trial, demo, and contact paths.

  

**Required qualifications**

* 4+ years designing and managing a B2B marketing website, ideally for a SaaS or technical product.
* A portfolio of live websites you designed and built, showing strong visual design, layout, and UX judgment.
* AI search optimization (AEO/GEO) experience, with tools that track brand visibility in AI answers.
* Hands-on Framer experience: you have designed and shipped production pages, components, and CMS collections in Framer itself.
* Experience applying AI technologies to accelerate and transform marketing workflows.
* Brand and visual design skills: typography, color, composition, and creating web graphics with tools such as Canva.
* Deep Google Analytics 4 experience: custom events, conversions, explorations, audiences, and BigQuery export or Looker Studio reporting.
* Deep Google Search Console experience: diagnosing indexing and coverage issues, sitemap management, and Core Web Vitals.
* Proven experience attributing web-based marketing activity to sales pipeline.
* Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager, UTM governance, and consent management.
* Experience connecting web forms and tracking to a CRM (Salesforce strongly preferred), including lead source and campaign attribution.
* Technical SEO fluency: redirects, canonicals, schema markup, site structure, and page speed.
* Comfortable with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript for embeds, custom code, and tracking snippets.
* Clear writer and communicator who can turn data into a recommendation for non-analysts.

  

**Preferred qualifications**

* Framer Expert certification.
* Experience turning complex technical concepts into clear diagrams and product visuals.
* SEO tooling experience: Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse.
* Marketing automation and attribution tools experience.
* Experience marketing to engineers, scientists, or developers; familiarity with simulation, scientific computing, or developer tools is a plus.
* Experience in a venture-backed, high-growth environment.

title: Creative Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an imaginative and strategic Creative Content Writer / Copywriter who knows how to turn ideas into words that resonate and stick. At Zoodle Kid, we believe in storytelling that connects emotionally, communicates clearly, and drives engagement without sounding like a formulaic ad.

In this role, you will be the core voice behind our customer journeys crafting captivating ad hooks, high performing performance marketing copy, engaging organic social storytelling, and dynamic video scripts in both English and Kannada. You will work closely with our creative production, marketing, and pedagogy teams to articulate our mission of early childhood development to parents and educators.

Key Responsibilities

1. Performance Marketing & Ad Copywriting

* Write high-converting ad copy, attention-grabbing hooks, and actionable CTAs for digital campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google, YouTube, and display channels.
* A/B test varied communication angles, parent triggers, and pain points to systematically optimize click-through and conversion metrics.
* Develop persuasive copy for landing pages, promotional micro-campaigns, and product launches.

**2. Video Concepting & Scriptwriting**

* Ideate creative concepts and craft structured scripts for short-form video ads, reels, pedagogical explainers, parent testimonials, and brand films.
* Collaborate closely with the Video Production Manager and creative crew to align visual cues, presenter delivery, pacing, and on-screen graphics.
* Develop narrative treatments, voiceover scripts, and storyboard copy that communicate complex child development concepts simply and warmly.

3. Social Media & Organic Brand Storytelling

* Drive brand storytelling across social channels including Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube Community.
* Author relatable, educational, and share-worthy carousel copies, captions, and infographics tailored to modern parents.
* Maintain brand voice integrity, warmth, and consistency across all public communication touchpoints.

**4. Bilingual Content Adaptation (English & Kannada)**

* Write and adapt nuanced, culturally relevant copy fluently in both English and Kannada.
* Transcreate campaigns rather than translating literally, ensuring local cultural resonance, relatable colloquialisms, and emotional depth in Kannada communication.

**5. Collateral, Outreach & Email Copy**

* Draft engaging content for parent newsletters, email drip workflows, WhatsApp broadcast sequences, and community engagement initiatives.
* Write clear, intuitive copy for offline brochures, experiential event kits, and pedagogical literature.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Exceptional command over creative writing, storytelling, and conceptualization.
* Demonstrated ability to write punchy ad hooks, headlines, and conversion-focused copy.
* Strong understanding of video formats, pacing, visual transitions, and scripting structure.
* Native or professional working proficiency in both English and Kannada (verbal and written).
* Deep audience empathy—ability to speak authentically to parents and early childhood educators.

Strong time management and agility to handle simultaneous campaigns in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Experience: 3+ years of professional copywriting, creative content writing, or digital advertising experience.
* Language Requirement: Professional proficiency in both English and Kannada is mandatory.
* Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating published campaign copy, social media traction, and produced video scripts is required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Advertising, Marketing, or related fields (proven writing track record prioritized over specific degrees).

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Performance Ad Metrics: Hook retention rate, click-through rates (CTR), and conversion performance of written ad sets.
* Organic Growth & Engagement: Engagement rates, shares, and audience retention on organic social posts and video content.
* Delivery & Turnaround: On-time delivery of scripts and campaign assets against the production calendar.
* Language & Brand Quality: Accuracy, tone consistency, and cultural resonance across both English and Kannada deliverables.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Content connects genuinely with parents and builds strong trust without feeling transactional.
* Ad copy and video scripts systematically produce top-performing creative hooks across digital channels.
* Video scripts translate seamlessly onto camera with minimal structural friction or rewrites.
* Kannada and English messaging resonate equally well with their respective target demographics.

Interested candidate can share their CV at meekha.gogoi@zoodlekid.com
